say:2:1322044001:1.text: Did you forget what I said last time, Daimon? Why did you sneak out again?
say:2:1322044001:1.source_cn: 戴蒙，你忘了我上次是怎么说的？为什么还要偷偷跑出来？！

say:4:1322044003:1.text: How dare you come to Cedartown?! Have you forgotten that you're a Graveborn? The people here are afraid of you and will hurt you!
say:4:1322044003:1.source_cn: 你居然还敢跑到雪松镇里来！你忘了你是个亡灵吗？这里的人...

say:5:1322044004:1.text: No, Mother. Alex and others are nice to me...*Cough*... I promise I won't come during the daytime.
say:5:1322044004:1.source_cn: 不会的，妈妈。亚历克斯他们对我都很好……咳咳，我……我...

say:6:1322044005:1.text: Look, Daimon! You're still coughing. You're still weak. How can I not worry?!
say:6:1322044005:1.source_cn: 戴蒙，你还在咳嗽！你身体那么弱，我怎么能放心？！

choice_prompt:7:1322044005.text: Look, Daimon! You're still coughing. You're still weak. How can I not worry?!
choice_prompt:7:1322044005.source_cn: 戴蒙，你还在咳嗽！你身体那么弱，我怎么能放心？！

say:8:1322044006:1.text: You don't understand! Daimon was in a bad state before. He was frailer than he is now, and one wrong move could leave him bedridden for months.
say:8:1322044006:1.source_cn: 你不明白！戴蒙从前身体就不好，他那时候比现在还瘦弱，一...

say:9:1322044007:1.text: He's my precious boy. Even the slightest worry on his face breaks my heart.
say:9:1322044007:1.source_cn: 戴蒙是我最宝贵的明珠，哪怕他眉头出现一丝忧虑，都会将我...

say:10:1322044008:1.text: All you care about is playing with him, but you don't care about his health or safety at all! Daimon's body can't handle being outside alone for too long!
say:10:1322044008:1.source_cn: 你们只知道哄他玩耍，可根本不顾他的身体，也不在意他的安...

say:13:1322044009:1.text: Why are you scaring him?! He's a fun and lively boy! If he doesn't play, his life will be boring!
say:13:1322044009:1.source_cn: ……你为什么吓唬他？他很好玩，很有趣，很活泼！你阻止他...

say:14:1322044010:1.text: You're a Graveborn who lives here?

say:15:1322044011:1.text: You're broken... like a toy that's been cast aside. You have the body of a man but the mind of a child. Can you even control yourself, or are you lost in your own chaos?
say:15:1322044011:1.source_cn: 你……你坏了，像一个被错装的玩具。成年人的身躯，却有孩...

say:16:1322044012:1.text: Daimon, come here. Don't stand next to him. He's dangerous.
say:16:1322044012:1.source_cn: 戴蒙，快过来，不要再和他站在一起了，他很危险……

say:18:1322044014:1.text: He's my son! I have a responsibility to protect him from people who want to hurt him!
say:18:1322044014:1.source_cn: 他是我的儿子！我有责任保护他，任何人都不许伤害他！

say:22:1322044016:1.text: S-she's so scary... Alex, run. Let's hurry home! Wait! No! Let's go find Captain Rodrigo!
say:22:1322044016:1.source_cn: 她……她好可怕……亚历克斯，快跑，快……快回家！不，去...

choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 你会不会有点过度担忧了？

choice:7:1:2.text: Kids need to play outside to be healthy.
choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 小孩子多在外面玩玩才能身体健康
